remarks:
This spacious home with a wrap-around porch sits on a spacious lot located in the Village of Angelica NY, Allegany County.

Space, flexibility, and a location that keeps you connected to the community come together in this home. With 1,985 square feet, four bedrooms, hardwood floors, and a full wrap-around porch, this property offers the kind of layout and outdoor space buyers are looking for today.

The main living area includes a spacious living room, dining room, and an updated full bath creating a practical setup for everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen features updated cupboards and counters with plenty of workspace and storage, while the adjoining dining room provides plenty of room for gatherings and family meals. The main level also includes an additional front room that could work well as a downstairs bedroom, office, playroom, or second sitting area depending on your needs. Throughout the home, the hardwood floors add character and durability, and the room sizes provide flexibility for both daily living and entertaining. Upstairs, the four-bedroom layout offers comfortable space for family, guests, or work-from-home setups.

Outside, the wrap-around porch creates an inviting place to relax, decorate seasonally, or enjoy warm-weather evenings. The 0.48-acre lot gives you usable yard space for pets, gardening, outdoor furniture, or simply extra room to spread out.

Located within walking distance to Main Street and Park Circle, you’ll enjoy easy access to everything the Village of Angelica is known for, including local festivals, community events, shops, and seasonal activities throughout the year.

This is a home that combines space, function, and small-town convenience in a setting designed for everyday living.
